notes.title: September 16th Maintenance Complete
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,
The maintenance for September 16th, 2025, is complete.


1. You do roam around well outside in these embarrassing clothes......!

The "Lapis Taimanin Package" is out!
Don't miss the package deal where you can obtain a limited weapon, limited costume, and limited supporter exclusive to Lapis!

※ Limited supporter "【UR】 [Taimanin] Lapis" can be bought in the Shop of Desires and future VR Shop update.

Limited supporter "【UR】 [Taimanin] Lapis" can be purchased from the Shop of Desires.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Known Issue: Incorrect Settings Option on PC Versions
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.

After the maintenance on September 2, 2025, we have confirmed the following issue.

1. An incorrect option was displayed in the PC version Settings menu.
- This issue has been fixed. If the changes are not applied, please restart the game.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Known Issue: "[Back Alley] Ingrid" Appears in the Arena Store
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders.

After the scheduled maintenance on Sep. 2nd, 2025, we've identified the following issue:

1. The supporter "[Back Alley] Ingrid" was incorrectly displayed in the Arena Store on some accounts.

We've located the cause and fixed the issue.
For Commanders who have already purchased the supporter from the Arena Store, the supporter will be retrieved in turn and, 15,000 Arena Coins will be refunded during the scheduled maintenance on Sep. 16th, 2025.

As an apology, we have sent the following compensation to all commanders. Please check your mailbox.

※ Compensation: 3,000 Arena Coins

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you.

notes.title: September 2nd Maintenance Complete
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,
The maintenance for September 2nd, 2025, is complete.


1. Playable Character "Annerose Vajra" Renewal!

The modeling and animations of the playable character "Annerose Vajra" have had a makeover!

1-1. Annerose Renewal Celebratory Packages!

Two special packages, including a limited-time costume, a new UR weapon, and more, are up for grabs!
Don't miss out on the "New Fan Package," which includes the playable character, weapon, and costume for those meeting Annerose for the first time.
As well as the "Huge Fan Package" containing Demonite (UR), weapon, and "Gacha Coin Box"!

※ Sales Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ The playable character is only included in the 'New Fan Package'.
※ The Google Play package details differ from packages sold on platforms other than Google Play.

1-2. Annerose Renewal Celebratory Achievement Event!

An achievement event is being held to celebrate Annerose's renewal!
Clear missions and receive items necessary for advancing, leveling up, and increasing affinity!

◇ Renewal Celebration Missions
※ Event Period until: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Mission Details:
① Annerose Level-Up
└ Mission Rewards: Gems x 30 (Level 10), Gold x 50,000 (Level 20), Certificate x 40 (Level 30), Ore Kit x 10 (Level 40), Ore (Stellar) x 2 (Level 50), Ore (Stellar) x 4 (Level 60), Ore/Shard Box x 1 (Level 70), Crystal Kit x 1 (Level 75)
② Annerose Advancement
└ Mission Rewards: Gems x 30 (★2), Operational Plan x 20 (★3), Operational Plan x 20 (★4), Operational Plan x 20 (★5), Friend Emblem: Annerose x 2 (★6)
③ Clear Any Quest with Annerose
└ Mission Rewards: Gems x 30 (Clear 5 times), Enhancement Stone (High) x 10 (Clear 10 times), Strategy Manual (High) x 10 (Clear 25 times), Dango x 5 (Clear 50 times), Coffee x 5 (Clear 75 times), Sushi x 5 (Clear 100 times), Choco Banana x 5 (Clear 125 times), Pink Rose x 5 (Clear 150 times), Love Letter x 1 (Clear 200 times)
④ Annerose Affinity Level Up
└ Mission Rewards: Gacha Coin x 1 (Level 1), Gold Ingot (Large) x 10 (Level 2), Gacha Coin x 1 (Level 3), Gold Ingot (Large) x 20 (Level 4), Gacha Coin x 1 (Level 5)
⑤ Clear Any Quest with 3 Assist/Protect/Suppress type supporters equipped to Annerose
└ Mission Rewards: Nanometal (Red) x 2 (Clear 5 times), Fiber (Red) x 2 (Clear 10 times), Skill Points (2,000) x 1 (Clear 15 times)
⑥ Set Annerose as Main
└ Mission Rewards: Gems x 10
⑦ Upgrade Annerose's HP/ATK/CRI/Cooldown/Skill/DEF
└ Mission Rewards: Gems x 5 (Lv.5), Gems x 10 (Lv.10)

※ Commanders who have already leveled up and advanced Annerose before the mission was launched can also receive the rewards.

1-3. Balance Adjustments!

The performance of "Annerose Vajra" has been adjusted as follows:

- The visual effects, animations, area of effect, and damage of some skills have changed.
- A new unique skill has been added.
└ Yaksha's Wrath: Each time a skill is used, you gain 1 stack of Yaksha's Wrath. (stacks up to 3) Using a skill when Yaksha's Wrath is on a full stack depletes the gauge and activates Yaksha Unbound.
- The delay before and after using the skill "Yaksha Itto Style" has been reduced.
- The delay before and after using the skill "Madousen" has been reduced, and its basic effect and slot effects have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Slashes enemies with enlarged blade and deals an area attack. ▶ Thrusts forward with an enlarged blade dealing an area attack ahead, restoring HP equal to 3% of the damage dealt.
└ 2 Assist-Type Supporters: Add area attack at the end of the skill and restore HP by 3% of damage dealt ▶ Increase speed by 10% for 10 seconds
└ 2 Suppress-Type Supporters: Stun the enemy ▶ Decrease enemy defense by 10% for 10 seconds
- The skill "Fleuretty's Grudge" has been fixed to enable attack by using the attack button while in counter-attack stance, and its basic effect and slot effect have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Assuming a stance to counter-attack to hugely reduce incoming damage, and when hit, things come out of the trunk and counter-attack enemies. ▶ Assumes a counter stance, greatly reducing damage taken. When attacked, contents of the trunk burst out and deal a counterattack to the front. On a successful counter, gain 1 additional stack of Yaksha's Wrath.
└ 2 Protect-Type Supporters: Knock down the enemy ▶ Reduce enemy speed by 20% for 5 seconds
- The basic effect and slot effect for the skill "Yaksha Unbound" have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Extreme Dodge activates the witch's sense that increases Crit. rate, damage, and defense for 4 seconds. ▶ Extreme Dodge activates the witch's sense, increasing critical rate, damage, and defense for 6 seconds.
└ 2 Assist-Type Supporters: Increase the duration by 2 seconds ▶ Additionally increase ATK by 10%
- The delay after using the skill "Devour" has been reduced, and its basic effect and slot effects have been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Whips black strands reaching out from the sword and restores HP by 3% of the damage dealt; Attack range increases when the skill slot is applied. ▶ Flail tendrils extending from the sword the deal an area attack, restoring HP equal to 3% of the damage dealt. Pulls enemies in when slot effect is applied.
└ 3 Protect-Type Supporters: Pull the enemy towards the character ▶ Pull an enemy towards the character and does an additional attack
└ 3 Suppress-Type Supporters: Stun the enemy ▶ Decrease enemy defense by 30% for 10 seconds
- The basic effect for the skill "Divine Wrath" has been changed.
└ Basic Effect: Teleports to the nearest enemy and performs a falling attack with dark lightning. ▶ Teleports behind the neareast enemy and performs a diving attack with black lightning, and creates a field of lightning on the attack spot that deals damage over time for 3 seconds.
- The delay before using the skill "Hyakuretsusen" has been reduced, and its slot effects have been changed.
└ 2 Assist-Type Supporters: Perform an additional attack that knocks back the enemy at the end of the skill ▶ Perform an additional attack at the end of the skill, making the enemy groggy
└ 3 Assist-Type Supporters: Increase critical rate by 50% ▶ Increase critical rate by 50%, reduce enemy speed by 40% for 7 seconds


2. Special Limited Package Released!

A special package where purchase streak rewards are given!
The "Task Force Special Assemble" where commanders can obtain Exclusive Trial Supporters and Nanomachine (UR)!

※ Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Please check the in-game shop page for more details of "Task Force Special Assemble".
※ Purchase Streak Reward: "Voucher: Exclusive Trial Supporter" x 1 (Purchase 5 times), "Nanomachine (UR)" x 1 (Puchase 10 times)
※ Purchase streak rewards can be checked and claimed by clicking the present box icon of each package on the bottom right corner of the sales page.
※ Purchase streak rewards can only be acquired during the sales period for each package. Please acquire the rewards before the end of the sales period.
※ Gacha Rate: 21 UR Supporters each 4.714%, Nanomachine (UR) 1% 

2-1. Selection Gacha Added!

To celebrate the release of the "Task Force Special Assemble",
A limited-time "Selection Gacha" where commanders can pick their own pickups will be added! 

※ Gacha Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Selection Available: One of 21 UR Supporters
※ Please check the in-game gacha page for more details.
※ "Limited Gacha Coin" can be used in the Selection Gacha.


3. New Private Room Theme Package Released!

The "Cafe Package," which allows commanders to obtain the new private room theme "Cafe" along with various poses and costumes, is now available!

※ The Cafe Package can only be bought on platforms other than Google Play.
※ Sales Period: ~ December 2nd, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)

3-1. Permanent Private Room Theme Added!

The "Luxury Room" private room theme will be converted to a permanent series.

※ Price: Gems x 800


4. September Seasonal Events!

4-1. Login Event #1 is Running!

Gifts for all users who log in every day! 
A chance to obtain Cara Cromwell's limited costume "Autumn Vampire"!
Log in for a total of 7 days out of 14, and receive various gifts!

※ Event Period: After maintenance on September 2nd, 2025 ~ September 16th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Users who log in before maintenance will be processed starting from September 2nd, 2025, at 15:00 (UTC).

4-2. Surprise Missions & Surprise Campaign #1 Commences!

Surprise missions and campaign will be held during the Seasonal Event!
Take advantage of the perks during the campaign period to clear missions and receive rewards!

※ Please refer to the game's exact schedule for each week.

◇ Surprise Mission
※ Event Period: ~ September 9th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Mission Details: 
① Clear Event Quests
└ Mission Rewards: Fiber (Colorless) x 2 (Clear 10 times), Material Kit (Normal) x 10 (Clear 20 times), Crystal Fragment x 3 (Clear 30 times), Blank Emblem x 5 (Clear 50 times), Operational Plan x 10 (Clear 70 times), Weapon "【UR】 Mech Sword: Reverse Inferno" (Clear 100 times), Supporter "【UR】 [Back Alley] Ingrid" x 1 (Clear 200 times)

◇ Surprise Campaign
※ Event Period: ~ September 9th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Campaign Perks
└ Event Quest AP multiplier max. 5 increase


5. The new event "This is a Gosha 'Welcome Party'─!" is now open!

Clear event stages to obtain event gacha tickets,
and roll the Event Gacha for various rewards!

※ Event Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Even Gacha Period: ~ October 7th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Event Gacha Special Reward: Supporter "【UR】 Hasuma Reiko"
※ Please refer to in-game explanations for detailed information about the event.
※ Event-exclusive materials cannot be used in the next event.


6. Pickup Gacha is Live!

Pickup Gacha with an increased drop rate of weapons and supporters is open!
Roll the Gacha a certain number of times to get a guaranteed reward!

※ Each Pickup Gacha is separate and does not share the gacha progress bar.

◇ Pickup Gacha 1: Supporter "【UR】 Kuroda Tomoe"
※ Gacha Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ Supporter "【UR】 Kuroda Tomoe" can also be purchased in the Shop of Desires.

◇ Pickup Gacha 2: Annerose exclusive new weapon, "【UR】 Gundari"
※ Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)


7. Golden Pass is open!

Obtain a variety of rewards just by clearing missions!
Purchase the Special Pass and receive additional and limited rewards!

※ Special Pass Reward: Limited costume "Autumn Inageya" (Natsu), etc.
※ Golden Pass Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)

7-1. Golden Pass Double Rewards Event!

The number of mission reward items from the Golden Pass and Special Pass will be doubled!

※ Event Period: ~ September 30th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)
※ This does not apply to the Limited costume included in the Special Pass reward.


8. Limited-Time Costumes Return!

3 Limited-Time costumes of the "Autumn Breezes" series are back!
 
※ Returning Costumes: "Autumn Hunter" (Rinko), "Autumn Dragon" (Su), "Fantom Fall Festival" (Shiranui)
※ The costumes "Autumn Hunter" and "Fantom Fall Festival" is only available for purchase on platforms other than Google Play.
※ Sales Period: ~ September 16th, 2025, 01:59 (UTC)


9. Improvements and bug fixes
└ The "Total War" Relay Mode ranking board is changed so that the team with the highest score is displayed.
└ The conditions for unlocking Auto-Finish on "Taima-Five VR" has been changed. Now all stages below the highest stage cleared under a minute on the current sesason is available for Auto-Finish.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Improvements and Changes in Taima-Five VR
notes.content:
Greetings from the Action Taimanin Team.

Since its release, Taima-Five VR(hereafter VR) has served as a key piece of content to test your characters' growth and power.
However, as the game continues to expand with more diverse content, it came to our attention that VR has also become stale, and a source of fatigue for many players.

We will therefore implement the following changes to VR to improve your gameplay experience after the maintenance on June 3rd, 2025:

1. Partial Retention of Progress After Season Resets

Current: All progress resets; players restart from Step 1 after every season
After: Progress will now be saved in 10-step intervals (e.g.: If you finished the previous season on Step 65, you would begin the new season from Step 60.)

※ This system will be applied after the maintenance on June 3rd, 2025, so the actual implementation of the new system will take effect starting June 10th, 2025, at 03:00 (UTC).
※ As the previous season's record is partially saved, balance adjustments will be made to VR Bosses Queen Kanaloa, and Tenkyu #2.


2. Expansion of Step Unlock Based on Clear Time

Current: Clearing a Step unlocked up to 3 Steps.
After: You can now unlock up to 5 Steps based on your clear time.


3. VR Auto-Finish Feature Added

If a Step is cleared in the ongoing season, and the Step is cleared within 60 seconds, you can Auto-Finish the Step.
Auto-Finishing VR Steps consume BP and Operational Plans, and deployed characters will lose 10% HP per run.


Thank you.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Incorrect Pricing of a supporter in VR Shop and 1 Additional Issue
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.

Following the maintenance on November 5th, 2024, we have identified and addressed the following issues:

- The supporter “[Massacre] Shinganji Kurenai” was listed at 5,000 VR Points instead of the intended 15,000 VR Points.
- The supporter “[White Knight] Igawa Asagi” was mistakenly included in the Exchange Facility’s item list.

Here is how we have resolved these issues:

1. The price for “[Massacre] Shinganji Kurenai” will remain at 5,000 VR Points for the rest of the current sales period.
2. Users who purchased “[Massacre] Shinganji Kurenai” at the original price of 15,000 VR Points before maintenance have been refunded 10,000 VR Points (reward distribution complete).
- After this sales period, the next limited-time supporter will be sold at the intended price of 15,000 VR Points.
3. The Exchange Facility issue has been corrected. Please restart the game if you have not received the update.

We are committed to preventing similar issues in the future and apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.

Fixed an anomaly where characters would appear incorrectly in some scenarios.

notes.title: 【New Content Update】 Club
notes.content:
On October 1st, 2024, the new "Club" guild system will be officially added!
Join a Club to receive Club-exclusive rewards and explore new content where you can cooperate with other commanders!


◇ Creating and Joining a Club

Only commanders with a rank of 30 or higher can create a Club, but anyone can join. However, if your in-game language differs from the Club’s main language, you may be restricted from joining. The Club Master can decide whether to allow/deny applications on the Club’s information page, and a Club can have up to 20 members.

Club Chatting: A communication tool for commanders in the same Club. You can chat with each other or check updates such as other members' rare item acquisitions or successful enchants. Members can individually set what information is shown in the chat.
Club Login: By logging in daily, commanders can receive a Club Login Bonus. In addition to the basic login bonus rewards, a special login bonus focused on items, gacha, and more will be offered at a low cost.
Club Buff: Clubs offer commanders various buffs that help in battles. Club Buffs are applied individually and can be upgraded with Club Buff Points which are given based on the number of characters each commander owns. Club Buffs can be stacked with existing Awaken Skills.
Club Party: The Club Master can activate a maximum of 2 buffs that apply to the entire Club for a certain amount of time.
Club Donation: By donating various materials, commanders can earn Club Points and Club Attribute Points. Club Attribute Points are tracked daily and reset anew every 15:00 (UTC), which is applied to the Club Rank in real-time.
Club Store: Use Club Points obtained from Club Donations to buy various items. As the Club Store level increases, so does the item variety. The paid Club Package is also available at the Club Store, and when one member purchases it, all other members receive additional presents.
Club Facilities: Use Club Attribute Points to upgrade facilities within the Club. Upgrading facilities will upgrade the Club Party, Club Store, and Club Donation levels while increasing the maximum level for Club Buffs available to members.
Club Pass: Earn Club Pass rewards by completing Club Pass missions, and unlock a special reward with a special reward key obtained from the Club Store, etc. The Club Pass mission progress reflects the combined efforts of all members. 

◇ Club Rank
Weekly/Monthly Club Ranks are tallied through a sum of Club Attribute Points gained from Club Daily Login and Club Donation. Be sure to participate in club activities to reach higher ranks.

◇ Club Quests
Club-exclusive battle content such as Club Raid will be added through future updates.
These contents will be designed to cooperate with other members to receive various items as rewards.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Two changes including balance adjustments
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.

The following is the pre-notice for changes including supporter balance adjustments that will be applied after the scheduled maintenance on May 6th, 2024.


1. Supporter "[UR] Torajiro"

Before (stats are based on sLv. 1)

◇ Sub - Wild Blood
      When performing a melee attack, has a 15% chance to increase the duration of 2 buffs by 1 second
◇ Main - Weretiger's Roar
      Roar loudly and deal 440% damage to surrounding enemies, making them groggy. If the enemy is a human-type, their speed is decreased by 15% for 5 seconds.

Changed (stats are based on sLv. 1)

◇ Sub - Wild Blood
      Increase damage dealt to all enemies by 15%
◇ Main - Weretiger's Roar
      Passive: When performing a basic melee attack, has a 15% chance to increase the duration of 1 buff by 1 second
      Active: Roar loudly and deal 440% damage to surrounding enemies, making them groggy. If the enemy is a human-type, their speed is decreased by 30% for 5 seconds.


* The supporter "[UR] Torajiro" had been favored by many Commanders due to her remarkable utility. However, we adjusted some of her skills because she had been more effective than she was designed to be.


2. Defense Stats

The DEF stats will have changes as follows.

1. Revised the formula that modifies defense(DEF) stats to damage reduction rate.
2. Revised the way how the "Upgrade DEF" is applied.
3. Changed the maximum number of increased DEF from the "Upgrade DEF". (Before: 20% → Changed: 50% / based on Level 25.)
4. Applied the maximum limit to the damage reduction rate.


* To ease the unsatisfactory gameplay experience during combats, especially in the Battle Arena, because characters can't deal damage when the opponent has reached more than a certain DEF stat, we have adjusted some formulas and numbers related to defense stats.
  We will watch what changes the adjustments will bring, and do our best to provide a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Known Issue: Purchasing Special Pass more than once (Resolved)
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders.

We have identified the following issue after the update on October 24th, 2023.

- Special Pass which is already purchased is available for purchase again.

The Special Pass that was purchasable is the same Special Pass as the one that began on October 4th. The issue occurred whilst applying the purchase period extension for Special Pass due to transaction errors on the Google Playstore from October 11th to Ocotober 16th.

Commanders who purchased the Special Pass again even though they have already purchased October's Special Pass, please contact our customer support (support@gremorygames.com) including your User ID and receipts and we will resolve the problem promptly.
* Google Playstore: Receipts that include Google order number. (Starts with GPA.)
* Apple Appstore: Receipts already processed and given a transaction ID. (Pending receipts are not eligible)
* Steam: Receipts that include Steam order number. (Consists only of numbers)

We apologize for any confusion we may have caused.

Thank you

└ Fixed an anomaly caused by server discrepancy during facility usage.

notes.title: Summer Special Store for July Preview
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders. Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.
We would like to inform you about the updates made to the in-game store, designed to enhance your experience and help you stay cool during the hot summer season.


① Introducing "Amane's Discount Threat", a special discount page just for July.

A special page where you can find all the discounted items will be added. You can check special offers for packages on this page.

※ Special Offers Available For: Hebi-Shika's Helping Hands (30 days), July's Special Pass, Steel Witch Package (Standard)
※ Hebi-Shika's Helping Hands (Special Offer) will be granted as a different item, and you can purchase the package regardless of the remaining period of your current one.
※ Hebi-Shika's Helping Hands (Special Offer) is activated only when using the item you receive upon purchasing the package.


② July Early Access! Meet the "Summer Costume Buffet" package where you can acquire limited costumes at a special price!

A special package where you can acquire 3 limited-time, swimsuit costumes will be released.

※ Costumes included in the respective package.
- Summer Costume Buffet 1: Glowing Pearl (Sakura), Undying Flower (Murasaki), Summer Whirlwind (Kurenai)
- Summer Costume Buffet 2: Beach Side Kitty (Yukikaze), Phantom by the Beach (Shiranui), Beachside Knight (Ingrid)
- Summer Costume Buffet 3: Hunter on Vacation (Rinko), Beach Melon (Su), Hottest Blizzard (Kirara)

※ The costumes will be available for Gems in the store a week after the packages' release.


③ A brand-new limited package "Task Force 101 Package" will be released.

The "Task Force 101 Package" consists of four packages. You can purchase the second package if you acquire the first package, which is available for free. 
The packages include "Task Force Document", "Voucher: Ultimate Weapon", "Voucher: Pickup Supporter" and other generous items, and they are available at a reasonable price!

※ Special Rewards included in each package:

- Step 1: "Hebi-Shika's Day Off (1 Day)" x1
- Step 2: "Task Force Document" x1, Hebi-Shika's Day Off (3 Days) x1
- Step 3: "Voucher: Ultimate Weapon" x1, "Ticket: Limited Weapon & Supporter" x1
- Step 4: "Voucher: Pickup Supporter" x1, "Ticket: Limited Weapon & Supporter" x1


④ Changes and new packages for the Weekly & Monthly Packages

Starting in July, there will be new packages as well as changes made to Weekly & Monthly Packages.
First of all, free Weekly & Monthly Packages will be added. Check the in-game store every week, or month, and claim free rewards including gems, Operational Plan, and Gold.

The details and price of the Weekly Gacha Package will change. And the "Weekly Enchant Package" where you can acquire materials for Enchantment, such as "Orb Kit (UR)", and "Element Kit (UR)" will be added.

The details and price of the Monthly Supporter/Weapon Upgrade Package and Monthly Awakening Package will change. Plus, a "Monthly Magatama & Gold Package" where you can acquire "Voucher: UR Magatama", "Bead (UR)", and "Magatama Gacha Ticket" will be added.

1. Playable character "Su Jinglei" gets renewed!

1-1. New package released to celebrate the renewal of Su Jinglei!

To celebrate this renewal, two special packages including Su-exclusive costumes and items are being released!
Don't miss out on the "White Belt Newbie Package" for people who have never tried Su before, and the "Black Belt Master Package" who want to further upgrade Su!

※ Sales Period: Until April 4th, 2023 01:59 (UTC)
※ The playable character is only included in the "White Belt Newbie Package".

1-2 Balance Adjustment!

We have made the following changes to the performance of "Su Jinglei":

- The visual effects of some skills have been changed.
- The delay before and after using basic attacks and the skill "Taimanin Art: Blaze Dance" have been reduced.
- The attack area of the skill "Ryuuhashin" has been increased and the slot effect has been partially changed.
└ Supporter (Protect) Set 1: Attack area increased by 80% ▶ Attack area increased by 60%
- The attack area of the skill "Nakuryuusou" has been increased and the skill motion and slot effect have been partially changed.
└ Supporter (Assist) Set 2: Cooldown time reduced by 20% ▶ Pull the enemy towards the character.
- The delay after using the skill "Shinryuuga" has been reduced.
- The interval between hits of the skill "Shunrenka" has been shortened, and if the enemy is beyond the attack area or dies while the skill is being used, the character will automatically target the nearest enemy.

notes.title: A preview of improvements in January
notes.content:
Introducing what will be improved with the update on Jan. 3rd, 2023.


1. Improvements in Affinity effects of the playable characters

The way Affinity effects are applied will be improved.
Now you won't have to set characters in the lobby for the effects to activate. The effects can now be activated from the commander info screen where you can set the supporter formation.
Choose the characters you want in the lobby!


2. Improvements in Selling / Dismantling items

When selling or dismantling items, you will now be able to view them according to their rarity and choose up to 50 items at a time.
Also, the days when you weren't able to dismantle items because your inventory was full are now in the past.


3. Improvements in matchmaking in the Battle Arena

The matchmaking system of the Battle Arena will be improved.
A lot more is now taken into account when matchmaking, so that the matchmaking experience of the Top-Class players, except for the Top 100 players, can be improved.


4. Improvements in the Random Shop's item information

The UI of the VR Shop will be improved.
We will add a feature where you can check daily/weekly/monthly items in the Random Shop.
Click the "?" mark at the bottom left of the Random Shop screen and check daily/weekly/monthly items along with permanent items which you can purchase without limitations.
※ Monthly items cannot be checked for the time being since there aren't any monthly restricted items in the VR Shop at the moment.


5. Improvements in the Rotation Gacha

We will improve the information on the Rotation Gacha.
From Jan. 3rd, characters that share a weapon will also appear in the information.

notes.title: Introducing our new content, Taima-Five VR
notes.content:
A raid quest "Taima-Five VR" officially launches on Dec. 6th, 2022.
Clear the raid quests and acquire various materials including UR magatamas.
You can also get VR points from the quests with which you can exchange rewards in the VR Shop and Random Shop!
※ Taima-Five VR is available for all the users who have cleared main chapter 18 (Easy).


◇ Combat
Taima-Five VR's difficulty increases in steps, depending on your clear time of the current step, from 1 to 3. The default raid screen is set to the highest difficulty available for entry, but you can also choose which step you want to enter.
※ Three characters must be selected to play Taima-Five VR, otherwise you cannot play.
※ The further you progress, the higher the item drop rate becomes. 

BP is used when entering, where bosses with random monster effects await you. You can strengthen your team before entering the stage by using the "Attack Codex", and "Health Codex".
※ More bosses will be added in future updates.

Three playable characters must be selected to play. You will only be controlling one of the characters, and the other two will be controlled by AI. The automatic use of the AI-controlled characters' supporter skills, weapon skills, and Ultimate can be selected from the raid screen.
You can switch your main character (the one you will control) with the two AI-controlled characters. The characters' HP will NOT be restored even after combat, so you have to use "Health Potion" to do that.
※ The characters' HP is restored at 15:00 (UTC) every day.

After clearing a stage, you can acquire various items such as VR Points, materials for evolving magatamas, crystal fragments, and Crystal (Mirage).
※ The amount of VR Points you can acquire a day is limited, and this is reset at 15:00 (UTC) every day. The amount of VR Points you've earned a day is shown on the main screen of Taima-Five VR.


◇ Shop
You can purchase items in the VR Shop and Random Shop with VR Points.
The VR Shop is always available. (Except for the ranking collecting time.) In the Random Shop, items change four times a day, but you can also manually change items with Gems. Use the Help button to view the list of items in the Shop.
※ Random Shop's items are renewed at 03:00, 09:00, 15:00, and 21:00 (UTC) every day.
※ Random Shop limited items: VR weapons, magatama evolving items, UR magatamas, etc.
※ Some items have a limited number of purchases during a certain amount of time. Please below for the detail.
    - Daily reset items: Crystal Fragment, UR Magatamas (All four types), Magatama Polishing Tool (All four types / VR Point available), Ritual Bell, Cutting Fluid, Element Kit (UR), Orb Kit (UR), Health Potion (S/M/L)
    - Weekly reset items: Crystal Kit, Crystal [Mirage] (Random Shop item), Magatama Polishing Tool (All four tyeps / Gem available), Random VR Weapons
    - Monthly reset item: Crystal [Mirage] (VR Shop item)


◇ Rankings
The rankings of the initial clear record and the fastest clear record are collected.
The progress and rank data are reset every Tuesday, from 02:00 to 03:00 (UTC). Personal best records are not reset.

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Changes in the rules of creating your Commander Name
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.

We are constantly finding users who intentionally use enojis and/or color codes in their Commander Names to deliberately make them appear incorrectly.
Therefore, we will add the following rules for setting your Commander Name in order to create a healthy game environment and provide better customer service,

    ※ A function to change the color of your Commander Name will be added in the future.

Commander Names which do not follow the aforementioned rules will be changed automatically during the scheduled maintenance on Sep. 6th, 2022 01:59 (UTC), so those which such Commander Names, please change your Commander Name beforehand.

Thank you.

Roll each gacha for a certain amount of time to get guaranteed rewards!

※ The gacha coin can't be used in limited gachas, and limited pickup gacha rewards cannot be obtained with normal gachas (Premium, Ticket gachas)

※ Available until Feb. 1st, 2022 01:59 (UTC)

- Added a feature that filters characters in the Character screen.
- You can now give multiple gifts simultaneously when increasing the affinity of a character. (※ You can still give only FIVE gifts a day.)
- When dyeing a costume, the part you dye is now highlighted.
- When exiting the training room, you are now sent back to the skill screen of the character.
- Added an ON/OFF feature which shows items and supporters that your characters have equipped at the top of the screen.
- Added and reorganized buttons in the Supporter information screen in the inventory, which shows their basic information, where to get them, and Supporter Formation data.
- You can now reorganize the order of characters in the Skill Training and EXP Training facilities.
- When finishing up in the Skill Training Facility, the character's current skill points and the acquired skill points are now shown at the same time.
- The maximum amount of items you can craft simultaneously is increased from 10 to 50.
- You can now set the same weapons/supporters that are set to your characters in Armory/Supporter Formation.
- Changed the icon that shows the detail of Armory.
- Revised how the Supporter Formations are organized in the Supporter Formation screen.
- Added filters in the Supporter Formation and a feature where you can select your favorite formations.
- 26 new Supporter Formations have been added.
- You can now see the icons of items you haven't acquired yet.
- When receiving Gems as rewards for reaching supporter intimacy levels, you can receive all the gems you can acquire in one go.
- Added a button where you can purchase or move to crafting facility in the Costume Collection.
- Added a feature where you can apply a private room theme right after purchasing it.
- When the server is about to shut down, the server shut-down message will remain on screen until the server shuts down.


8. Bug fixes!
- Fixed the anomaly on certain mobile devices where charge skill motions do not work properly.
- Fixed the anomaly where after finishing a quest and attempting to replay it with a multiplied AP setting, the AP refill pop-up appears even when you are not short on AP.
- Fixed the anomaly on certain costumes of the playable character "Kousaka Shizuru", where parts of the neck area do not appear properly when she does certain movements.
- Fixed the anomaly where the passive skill effect of supporter "Momochi Nagi" does not appear properly.
- Fixed the anomaly where the screenshot of the Private Room that's to be used as the lobby theme, doesn't show the whole Private Room.
- Fixed the anomaly where costumes of the second and third characters in the lobby are not displayed correctly.
- Fixed the anomaly where the color of the skill button does not change properly when selecting a skill in the Training Room.


9. Voice Change!

◇ New voices added!
New voices added for character interactions in the Battle Arena!
※ Characters: Igawa Asagi, Mizuki Yukikaze, Koukawa Asuka, Oboro, Onisaki Kirara

◇ "Kannazuki Sora"'s voice-actress changed!
Narumi Runa has retired from her role as the voice-actress for "Kannazuki Sora" due to personal reasons and will be replaced by Miss Aizawa Saya.

Thus, the following voice parts have changed.
※ Main Quest: Chapter 13, Chapter 15, Chapter 16
※ Supporter: In-game voice, Supporter scenario voices, etc.

We kindly ask all users of Action Taimanin for your understanding of the change of the voice actress.
Please welcome our new voice actress, Aizawa Saya.

Greetings Commanders,

2. New feature: Affinity!

Give gifts to playable characters!
As the affinity level increases, you can receive various benefits including new lobby animations, EXP, and bonus effects!

※ You can get items for increasing the affinity level from "Doki Doki Present". "Doki Doki Present" is obtainable through the Gold Gacha, FP Exchange, Arena Reward Box, Crafting Facility, Dispatch Mission etc.


3. New event "The Forgotten Beast and the Targeted Town" is live!

then exchange them for rewards in the exchange facility!

※ Event playable until Dec. 14th, 2021 01:59 (UTC)
※ Event Exchange Facility available until Dec. 21st, 2021 01:59 (UTC)

※ Event exclusive materials for the current event cannot be used in future events.


4. Pickup gacha is open!

※ Pickup gacha until Dec. 14th, 2021 01:59 (UTC)


5. Arena Tower levels increased!

25 floors have been added to the Arena Tower, expanding to 75 floors in total!
Go through breathtaking battles and reach the glorious top of the tower!


6. Store Updated!

○ "Weapon Voucher" in the Shop of Desires!!
Don't miss out on the "Voucher: Beast Weapon Ⅰ" in the Shop of Desires!

※ Available until Dec. 14th, 2021 01:59 (UTC)

○ New dispatch missions added!
Clear the new missions to acquire the newly added "Gacha Coin", "Rotation Gacha Coin", "Phantasmal Dye" and "Doki Doki Present"!


7. In-game Improvements!

○ General
- A button to instantly return to the lobby screen has been added.
- With the addition of the home button, the tutorial has been partially modified.
- The visual novel part when you first play the game has been partially modified.
- A function to select more than 10 items when selecting items has been added.
- The animation when you increase your Commander Rank has been modified to be skipped.

○ AP modifications
- When using an item that restores AP, you can now see how much AP is restored.
- After completing a quest, you can now see how much AP you have left.
- When restoring AP, you can now use AP potions before using your gems.

○ Gameplay modifications
- The visual novels now have a SKIP button (that fast forwards the dialogue) and the former skip function is now an "exit" function.
- The animation once you clear a stage can now be skipped.
- If you cleared all the sub missions after clearing a quest, a pop-up to collect gems will automatically appear.
- The Prologue Stage clear requirements needed before you begin the Battle Arena have been modified.
※ When you clear the Arena Prologue stages, you complete 20% of the progress of the Arena Prologue.

○ Gacha modifications
- The animations when rolling the gachas can now be skipped.
- The gacha's additional details section has been modified so that weapons and supporters are now separate from each other.

○ Collection modifications 
- In the full view screen for playable characters or supporters, you can now zoom in/out, and change to view them horizontally or vertically.
- A BACK button has been added when zooming in on a supporter in the Supporter collection and now it also shows the supporter type.
- The left and right spaces when zooming in on the 3D models in the Weapon collection have been adjusted.

○ Playable Character/Supporter/Weapon modifications
- The max. AP increase value is now displayed when purchasing a playable character.
- Fixed the anomaly where the list forcibly aligns to the left when clicking the BACK button after selecting a playable character.
- Added a scroll bar to the screen when selecting Awakening skills.
- Added an ATK, CRI, HP, and DEF sorting function to the Weapon and Supporter sorting options.

○ Shop modifications
- Purchasing multiple items at once is now available when purchasing Consumables.
- Modified the way Costumes are displayed in the Shop of Desires.

○ Private Room modifications
- General UI improvements such as displaying icons have been made when purchasing Private Room themes or options, etc.

○ Others
- A scroll UI has been added to the Main Quest list.
- After completing the Special Mode, you now go back to the quest menu instead of going back to the lobby.
- The supporter formation that meets the supporter formation requirements will now be displayed at the top.
- Added a UI that allows users to go to the FP exchange store from the friends list.
- Added a scrolling UI to the Welcome campaign and Comeback campaign reward list.
- The mission duration is now displayed in each mission of the Welcome campaign and Comeback campaign.


8. Bug fixes!
- Fixed the anomaly where players couldn't cancel the skill "Greataxe Style: Setsuga" by clicking the dash button during the additional spin attack when using the playable character "Yatsu Murasaki", and equipped with her weapon "A.D.W. Annihilator".
- Fixed the anomaly where certain costumes were not displayed translucently.
- Fixed the anomaly where the playable character "Shinganji Kurenai"'s skill "Gale Slash" would not work properly while using the charge skill.
- Fixed the anomaly where certain skills' debuff effects do not apply properly on enemies with super armor.
- Fixed the anomaly where the screen does not appear properly after performing certain actions in Section 2 of Chapter 16.
- Fixed the anomaly where the gacha probability of weapon gachas in the Rotation gacha is displayed incorrectly.
※ The correct probability distribution for the weapon gacha is "UR 3%, SR 35%, R 62%", the same as the probability of normal gachas.

Greetings Commanders, the maintenance for September 14th, 2021 is complete.

1. The Queen of the Inferno is here!

Roll the gacha a certain number of times and receive a voucher to obtain a UR weapon!

2. Golden Pass!
Receive various prizes just by clearing many missions!
Purchase the Special Pass to receive additional + exclusive rewards!
※ Special Pass Prize: Costume Voucher: Autumn Queen etc.
※ Pass purchasable until 2021, Oct 5th 01:59 (UTC)

3. Additional Costumes!
Dress up your Taimanins in “Autumn Breezes”!
Don't miss out on two new costumes!
※ Available for sale until 2021, October 5th 01:59 (UTC)
※ The sales period for the existing 4 “Autumn Breezes” costumes will not change.

4. Package Improvements
Let us introduce the newly improved Package products!
- A Jump-Up package has been added to help your Taimanin evolve faster!
(※ You cannot purchase BOTH the "Character Package" and the "Jump-Up Package", you can only purchase one package out of the two.)
- The starter package, which was a collection of everything you need to promote your Taimanin in the early stages, has been reorganized into three more powerful packages!
- The upgrade rewards of the Commander Jump-Start Package have been reorganized!
- A Weekly & Monthly Package is now available where you can purchase the materials needed to upgrade supporters, weapons and awaken characters!

※  Please understand that due to the change in packages, the "Upgrade Package" and "Commander Jump-Start Package 6" are no longer available.

5. Gacha Improvements
Let us introduce the newly improved Gacha!
Check out the Rotation Gacha, where you can pull different supporters and weapons every day!
※ The rotation gacha is reset every day at 15:00 (UTC), thus the rotation time differs by country.
※ The gacha that hasn’t rotated back yet can be purchased with gems until the gacha has been reset.

6. Improvements in the game and bug fixes
- Corrected the passive skill description of the weapon "Hermetic Megistus" to display the number of supporter set effect enhancements.
- You may now use Gems to proceed character promotion / awakening, supporter awakening, weapon forging, and in the facilities when you lack the required materials.
(※ Certain materials are not purchasable with Gems.)
- After you finish using the facilities, the previous items/character you worked on will remain equipped in the facilities.
- Fixed a bug where the rewards for clearing Chapter 15 in Time Attack aren't displayed correctly.
- Fixed a bug where a part of the next banner is displayed on the current banners.
- Fixed a bug where a crest's HP increasing options are not displayed correctly.
- Fixed a bug where the number of materials are not displayed correctly when resetting the crests.
- Fixed a bug where the Awaken Points are not displayed correctly after acquiring Awaken Skills.

notes.title: Announcement: Changes in price of playable characters
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Action Taimanin.


We have been receiving numerous requests and opinions from players about the price of our playable characters.

And after going through each and every one of them we have decided to adjust the price.


○ Playable Character Price Adjustment
